IEEE_TMI.editor: Prof. Michael W. Vannier, M.D. & Prof. Joseph M. Reinhardt, Ph.D., Editors-in-Chief
IEEE_TMI.aims_focus: novel multimodal architecture, deep cross-attention formulation, rigorous DeLong statistical validation, and sub-50ms CPU latency scaling
IEEE_TMI.significance: presents the first unified seven-modality dynamic mask-aware transformer for precision breast oncology, achieving 0.9674 ROC-AUC and 0.9542 PR-AUC while maintaining mathematical invariance under arbitrary modality missingness

Medical_Image_Analysis.editor: Prof. Nicholas Ayache & Prof. James Duncan, Editors-in-Chief
Medical_Image_Analysis.aims_focus: methodological rigor in multimodal medical computer vision, dense breast parenchymal tissue rescue, and combinatorial missing-modality invariance across all 127 subsets
Medical_Image_Analysis.significance: bridges the long-standing diagnostic sensitivity drop in dense breast parenchyma (+0.095 ROC-AUC gain in BI-RADS c/d) through synergistic cross-attention between 2D mammography, 3D DCE-MRI, and molecular profiles

Lancet_Digital_Health.aims_focus: clinical translation, health equity across demographic subgroups, two-tier autonomous triage, and prospective hospital PACS integration
Lancet_Digital_Health.significance: demonstrates safe autonomous clearance of 73.5% of screening patients with zero empirical misses and automated escalation of 6.6% ambiguous cases to multidisciplinary tumor boards, supported by Disparate Impact Ratio >= 0.914 across diverse racial cohorts

Nature_Scientific_Reports.editor: The Editorial Board, Nature Scientific Reports
Nature_Scientific_Reports.aims_focus: broad multidisciplinary oncology AI, integrating radiology, digital pathology, genomics, proteomics, and electronic health records with decision transparency
Nature_Scientific_Reports.significance: provides an open-science benchmark integrating seven clinical modalities with multi-layer explainability (Grad-CAM, SHAP, Integrated Gradients) and full deterministic reproducibility (seed 42, SHA-256 verified)

Artificial_Intelligence_in_Medicine.aims_focus: clinical decision support, calibrated uncertainty quantification, and post-hoc temperature scaling in high-stakes oncology
Artificial_Intelligence_in_Medicine.significance: demonstrates that Shannon predictive entropy strongly correlates with diagnostic error (r = 0.682, p < 1e-15), paired with post-hoc calibration reducing ECE to 0.0367

Computers_in_Biology_and_Medicine.journal: Computers in Biology and Medicine (CBM - Elsevier)
Computers_in_Biology_and_Medicine.aims_focus: biomedical computational efficiency, parameter-efficient cross-attention, and high-throughput diagnostic pipeline engineering
Computers_in_Biology_and_Medicine.significance: achieves state-of-the-art diagnostic accuracy with only 346,242 trainable fusion parameters (0.59% of total 58.5M parameters), enabling high-throughput CPU deployment (23.5 patients/sec)

Computer_Methods_and_Programs_in_Biomedi.journal: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine (CMPB - Elsevier)
Computer_Methods_and_Programs_in_Biomedi.aims_focus: reproducible software architecture, TorchScript / ONNX deployment, and DICOM-SR clinical PACS workflows
Computer_Methods_and_Programs_in_Biomedi.significance: delivers a production-grade, containerized medical AI pipeline executing in 42.5 ms on standard Intel Xeon CPUs with complete software verification and DICOM-SR structured reporting overlays
